question: What result follows for a steadfast person who recites Śiva at all three times?
premises: Recitation may occur while going or standing
Recitation is performed at the three times
The reciter is described as steadfast
inference: A steadfast reciter of Śiva at the three times may quickly obtain the desired result
uncertainties: Whether śivam refers to Śiva himself or an auspicious hymn
plain_english: If a steadfast person, whether going or standing, recites Śiva at the three times, he may quickly obtain the result.
